summary: 🌄 **FarLands** adds far grass, far building ruins, fire streaks on water and better HD Terrain colours, and starts much faster in a new world.
🧱 **AzuWearNTearPatches** is updated for Valheim 1.0 with new rain, ash, snow and damage settings.
🐾 **LetMeTameYou** brings back trading and hand feeding.
🌿 **ValheimVisuals** and **SteadyFrame** make far grass cheaper to draw, and reflections no longer show black marks.

bullets: Fixed Ember Charges doing no damage to the Gammeltroll when Prevent Easy Vein Finding is on.
Updated for Valheim 1.0, with structural integrity settings for Ice and Timberwood.
Separate rain, ash and snow damage toggles, and a new Damage section for fire, lava, creature and player damage.
New boat toggles for the boiling ocean and for being upside down.
The first start in a world is much quicker, as the far forest is now made on several threads.
Optional message when FarLands has finished loading, off by default.
Fixed far land looking brown, dark and patchy with HD Terrain packs, and the far Ashlands looking white.
Far grass and Plains flowers now reach the horizon, and the world's ruins, towers and houses are drawn far off.
Far bonfires look like real fires, are hidden by fog and by objects in front, and leave red streaks on water.
Fixed far snow and Mistlands colours with HD Terrain.
Trading and hand feeding are back.
Egg hatch time can be changed, and there is a new setting for hover width.
Works with other mods that change follow distance.
Grass updates are much cheaper when the grass distance is raised, with the same look.
Fixed black marks on reflective surfaces, such as the ice of the Deep North.
The grass radius setting now only applies when SteadyFrame is installed, to avoid a big performance cost.
Grass now reaches the full set radius instead of stopping at 100 m.
